sentences.text:
Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution o  for issuance of a Writ of Mandamus, directing the second respondent  appropriate orders on the reference/representation dated 29.11.2022  by the petitioner, by appointing competent Engineers/Officials for   the value of the structure and amenities in Petroleum Bunk etc., co  in S.No.418/3B and hence and pay appropriate compensation to the  petitioner by reconsidering the Awards dated 07.02.2021 by strictly  following the procedure contemplated under Sections 26 to 30 of Rig  Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitat  and Resettlement Act, 2013 (Central Act 30 of 2013) and re-fix the  compensation as per the provision of Schedule I and II and Section   and b of the Central Act 30 of 2013.
 For Petitioner : Mr.M.Selvam  For Respondent-1 : Mr.R.Subramanian,
 Central Government Standin  Counsel.

For Respondents-2 and 3: Mr.T.Arunkumar,
 Additional Government Pleade  For Respondent-4 : Mr.Sagar Ladda  Page 2 of 6 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis  WP No  ORDER
The land belonging to the petitioner was acquired for implementing Public Projects.
2. The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner made a submission that the Authorities Competent have determined the compensation to be settled.
3. Aggrieved by the determination, the petitioner submitted representation for reconsideration of the same and the said representation has not been considered.

sentences.text: 4. The learned Additional Government Pleader appearing on behalf of the respondents 2 and 3 brought to the notice of this Court that the District Collector has already decided the issues regarding enhancement of compensation and therefore, the petitioner has to prefer an appeal before the jurisdictional Principal District Judge for adjudication of issues.
Thus the petitioner is at liberty to file an appeal before the concerned Principal https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis District Judge for enhancement of compensation or otherwise.
5. With the above liberty, the writ petition stands disposed of.
However, there shall be no order as to costs.
Consequently, the connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
